definitions.explanation: A film director whose Rashomon (1950) won the top prize at the Venice Film Festival and opened Western eyes to Japanese cinema. Seven Samurai (1954) and his other period dramas influenced directors around the world.

examples.english: I watched a Kurosawa Akira film.

examples.english: Seven Samurai is Kurosawa Akira's best-known film, and it still influences many films today.
